SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF NOV-29-2023 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF NOV-29-2023 BY JUDGE PRO TEM PANG LY. PLAINTIFF IYARIN SRISUK IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF'S WITNESS TARATORN SARADIT. DEFENDANTS TRINITY MANAGEMENT SERVICES AND GREYSTAR INC. ARE PRESENT REPRESENTED BY KATTIE SHERIFF, AGENT FOR OWNER. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-29-2023 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SRISUK, IYARIN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT TRINITY MANAGEMENT SERVICES GREYSTAR CALIFORNIA.INC, $2,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $280.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,280.00, DEFENDANT FAILED TO ESTABLISH THAT THEY TIMELY COMPLIED WITH RETURN OF THE SECURITY DEPOSIT. PLAINTIFF'S DAMAGES ARE RELATED TO CREDIT CARD EXPENSE, BUT THERE IS NO BAD FAITH BY DEFENDANT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY SRISUK, IYARIN AS TO DEFENDANT TRINITY MANAGEMENT SERVICES GREYSTAR CALIFORNIA.INC, ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-29-2023 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
